facts.business: Ambar Protein Industries Limited is engaged in the business of protein products, with related party transactions involving sales of goods and leasing with Ankur Oil Industries.
facts.related_party_note: Related party transactions approved with Ankur Oil Industries for leasing/sublease/rent of Rs 1.00 Cr and sales of goods of Rs 400.00 Cr. Directors Mr. Pradeep C Khetani, Mrs. Shobhana J Vachhani, Mr. Jayprakash J Vachhani, Mr. Bharat D Patel, & Mr. Shirish D Patel are common partners.
